title: Canadian Beef Hash
description: A hearty, comforting dish made with corned beef, hash browns, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Brown the corned beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the hash browns to the skillet and cook until they start to brown.
Add the warmly spiced ground beef (if using) to the skillet and cook until combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Push the hash mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add a small amount of oil to the other side of the skillet.
Pour the beaten eggs into the oil and scramble them.
Mix the eggs with the hash mixture.
